insights.summary: From the Q1 FY27 presentation (3 August 2026; no call held): consolidated revenue rose 43% to ₹34 Cr with EBITDA up 65% (margin 25.3%) and PAT up 82% to ₹5.1 Cr. The chairman says the company aspires to triple consolidated revenue over three years, helped by subsidiaries that start earning in FY27 (injectables with ₹200 Cr peak potential, herbal and nutraceuticals) and existing plants running at only ~40% utilisation. FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹129 Cr (+48%) with a 21.8% EBITDA margin and ₹19 Cr PAT.

what_changed.text: Aim to triple consolidated revenue in three years
Peak revenue targets per subsidiary: injectables ₹200 Cr, medical devices ₹70 Cr, TNS ₹40 Cr, cosmetics ₹20 Cr, wellness ₹10 Cr
Planning a cephalosporin plant on 50,000 sq m of new land
Consolidated figures now reported alongside standalone

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: we remain confident in our long-term outlook and aspire to triple our consolidated business over the next three years

red_flags.text: Four of five subsidiaries are 51-60% owned, so part of the growth belongs to partners.
Consolidated operating cash flow only ₹4.7 Cr in FY26 against ₹37 Cr of investment; borrowings ₹73 Cr.
Working capital is heavy: consolidated debtor days 209 and inventory days 173 in FY26 (Screener).
Subsidiary pages carry placeholder text ('Lorem ipsum'), a sign of a rushed deck.

watch_next: Q2 consolidated revenue growth (tripling needs ~45% a year)
Injectables plant start and first revenue

business_snapshot.revenue_mix: FY26 consolidated: tablets 53%, capsules 24%, others (incl. devices) 23%
